discardDesc: Current changes are uncommitted. Going back will lose these edits.
overwriteWarning: Overwriting will discard this remote change.
remoteChangedAgain: The remote branch advanced again; overwrite aborted (draft kept, save again to re-run conflict flow)
remoteDeletedNote: The remote file has been deleted. "Force overwrite" will **recreate** the file with your content.
remoteUpdated: Remote updated, may overwrite others' changes
queuedInBackground: Queued for commit. The result will appear in notifications.
